name: mod-box
description: 17 Claude Code mods in one plugin, each switchable on its own; /mod-box opens the window to switch, configure and import mods.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the Mod Box window and of the texts its mods write (Next Steps, Catch Me Up, Heads-up, handoff note).

bandLayout.title: Band layout
bandLayout.description: compact: calm displays share one line; urgent ones (CI red, heads-up, sign offer) always get their own line. lines: one line per display.

bandOrder.title: Band order
bandOrder.description: Order of the displays above the prompt (switch keys, comma separated). The window sets it with arrows.

diagnose.title: Diagnosis: watch hooks
diagnose.description: on: the box notes every one of its hooks that fails (Diagnosis tab). Costs a little time per event; off switches it off.

importStrategy.title: Import strategy
importStrategy.description: automatic: plain function-hook mods are integrated into the box (switch, band, profiles); everything else is managed natively, as a plugin of its own. always native: every plugin is managed natively; the box switches, configures, updates and removes it.

blastRadius.title: Blast Radius
blastRadius.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would hit.

secretGuard.title: Secret Guard
secretGuard.description: Stops before Claude writes API keys, tokens, private keys or a non-ignored .env into files, git add or commits. Exceptions for test keys and example files: /secret-allow.

packageGuard.title: Package Guard
packageGuard.description: Before Claude installs or runs a package (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, npx, pip, uv, poetry, pipx, cargo), asks the public registry about it. Holds the command when the package does not exist (a made-up name), is under 14 days old, or looks like a well-known package and is young or thin (typosquatting). Allow in the band or with /pkg-allow.

ciWatch.title: CI Watch
ciWatch.description: After every git push, follows the GitHub Actions runs (via gh) until they finish; with an open pull request (also after gh pr create, or /ci pr <nr>) all its checks, other CI included, and whether it is ready to merge. On red it shows the failed step log.

signGuard.title: Sign Guard
signGuard.description: Spots Windows builds (cargo --release, dotnet publish, go build, pyinstaller, tauri, electron-builder, msbuild) and signs the new .exe/.msi/.msix with your own signing script.

savvyProgress.title: Savvy Progress
savvyProgress.description: Progress bar above the prompt and an agents panel (/agents-info) for subagents.

filetree.title: Filetree
filetree.description: File tree side pane (/filetree); files light up when Claude reads or writes them. With the Codebase Map on, a Features tab shows its features, what Claude is editing and the blueprint actions.

replayTheater.title: Replay Theater
replayTheater.description: Step through the last turn's file edits one diff at a time (/replay).

nextSteps.title: Next Steps
nextSteps.description: After each answer, 2-3 likely next prompts (1-3 drafts one, 0 dismisses). Costs tokens: a small Haiku call per answer.

cacheMeter.title: Cache Meter
cacheMeter.description: Band: time left on the warm cache, hit rate, context as weather, plan limits, compact and keep-warm buttons; stops one send to a cold cache and names its cost (Cache Tax runs inside). Costs tokens: keep-warm requests, only when switched on.

subagentSaver.title: Subagent Saver
subagentSaver.description: Search subagents (Explore) that were given no model of their own run on a cheaper one instead of the main model. An explicit model, forks, teammates and plugin agents stay untouched.

handoff.title: Handoff Note
handoff.description: /handoff writes a handoff note to .claude/handoff.local.md; a new session offers to continue from it. Costs tokens: one request over the warm cache per note.

visibleCompact.title: Visible Compact
visibleCompact.description: Shows before and after of /compact side by side; /show-last-compact reopens it.

readGuard.title: Read Guard
readGuard.description: Holds a whole-file Read (no offset/limit) of a file above the limit, a lockfile, minified code or a source map, and the same via cat, type or Get-Content in the shell; tells Claude the size, a token estimate and a better way (Grep, offset/limit). A second try at the same file goes through. Claude Code itself stops only at about 25,000 tokens.

headsUp.title: Heads-up (You Should Know)
headsUp.description: A second model reads longer answers and raises one easily missed but important point. Costs tokens: a small Haiku call per longer answer.

catchMeUp.title: Catch Me Up
catchMeUp.description: Side pane with a live summary of the session (/catch-me-up). Costs tokens: Haiku calls after turns that used tools.

codebaseMap.title: Codebase Map
codebaseMap.description: Feature map of the codebase from docs/blueprints: dependency graph with live highlighting of the features Claude edits, a freshness band, a CLAUDE.md pointer for agents and mapper instructions (machine-checked edges, optional Confluence mirror) that load only when you ask for blueprint work. Costs tokens: Only when you ask for blueprint work: creating a blueprint reads the whole repo once (hundreds of thousands of tokens on a large repo), an update reads only the changed features. While a blueprint exists, the CLAUDE.md pointer adds about 500 tokens per session (switch off with the CLAUDE.md option)..

secretMode.title: Secret Guard: mode
secretMode.description: block: refuse the action. warn: only warn and let it through.

secretPlaceholders.title: Secret Guard: let placeholders pass
secretPlaceholders.description: on: values with EXAMPLE, DUMMY, FAKE, PLACEHOLDER, REDACTED, SAMPLE, xxxxxx … are no secret (this covers the AWS documentation keys).

packageMode.title: Package Guard: mode
packageMode.description: block: hold the command until the package is allowed. warn: only warn and let it through.

packageGuardShow.title: Package Guard: display
packageGuardShow.description: band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. off: not shown (the mod keeps working).

ciInterval.title: CI Watch: poll every … seconds
ciInterval.description: How often gh is asked for the state of the runs.

ciOnRed.title: CI Watch: on red
ciOnRed.description: pane: open the log pane. prompt: put an analysis request into the prompt (not sent). both.

ciSound.title: CI Watch: sound
ciSound.description: on: a short sound when the runs are green or red (Windows: system sounds).

ciWatchShow.title: CI Watch: display
ciWatchShow.description: band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. off: not shown (the mod keeps working).

signMode.title: Sign Guard: mode
signMode.description: ask: offer a sign button. auto: sign right away.

signSubject.title: Sign Guard: certificate
signSubject.description: Files already signed by a certificate whose subject contains this are skipped. Empty: any validly signed file is skipped.

signGuardShow.title: Sign Guard: display
signGuardShow.description: band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. off: not shown (the mod keeps working).

savvyLanguage.title: Savvy Progress: language
savvyLanguage.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting.

filetreeActivity.title: Filetree: Claude activity
filetreeActivity.description: Which of Claude's file accesses light up in the tree.

filetreeGlyphs.title: Filetree: glyphs
filetreeGlyphs.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when installed (not in the desktop app); plain is Unicode only.

filetreeFollow.title: Filetree: follow Claude
filetreeFollow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude touches.

filetreeOpen.title: Filetree: open with
filetreeOpen.description: Empty: default app. preview: show in the pane. Anything else is a command; {path} is the file, {dir} its folder.

cacheMeterTtl.title: Cache Meter: cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMeterTtl.description: 60 on a subscription (Pro/Max), 5 for the API's default cache.

cacheMeterLimits.title: Cache Meter: show plan limits
cacheMeterLimits.description: Usage of the 5-hour and the weekly window.

cacheMeterGuard.title: Cache Meter: cold-cache guard
cacheMeterGuard.description: refuse: stop one send to a cold cache with a large context and name the cost (send again to pay). warn: only show the cost. off.

cacheMeterKeepWarm.title: Cache Meter: keep warm for … hours
cacheMeterKeepWarm.description: How long the keep-warm button keeps the cache warm (one small request over the cache about every 50 minutes of idle).

cacheMeterAutoWarm.title: Cache Meter: keep warm after a cold write
cacheMeterAutoWarm.description: on: after a paid cold write, keep the cache warm for 3 hours by itself (costs tokens).

cacheMeterAutoCompact.title: Cache Meter: auto-compact at
cacheMeterAutoCompact.description: Sets Claude Code's autoCompactWindow. On 1M-context models Claude only compacts by itself at about 967k tokens, and every turn re-reads the whole context until then. auto = Claude's default.

cacheMeterShow.title: Cache Meter: display
cacheMeterShow.description: band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. off: not shown (the mod keeps working).

subagentSaverModel.title: Subagent Saver: model
subagentSaverModel.description: Model for the listed subagent types. Sonnet searches nearly as well as Opus; Haiku is cheaper but may miss things, which then costs a second search on the main model.

subagentSaverTypes.title: Subagent Saver: agent types
subagentSaverTypes.description: Built-in subagent types to route, comma separated.

subagentSaverShow.title: Subagent Saver: display
subagentSaverShow.description: band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. off: not shown (the mod keeps working).

handoffAuto.title: Handoff Note: automatic
handoffAuto.description: on: written by itself shortly before the cache goes cold (when the context is large).

handoffShow.title: Handoff Note: display
handoffShow.description: band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. off: not shown (the mod keeps working).

compactStorage.title: Visible Compact: storage
compactStorage.description: temp: the OS temp folder. home: ~/.claude/visible-compact, kept.

readLimit.title: Read Guard: limit (KB)
readLimit.description: Files above this size are held when read whole. off: only lockfiles, minified files and source maps.

readMode.title: Read Guard: mode
readMode.description: block: hold the first try and tell Claude a better way. warn: only a notice.

readShell.title: Read Guard: shell too
readShell.description: on: also cat, type and Get-Content of a whole file.

headsUpShow.title: Heads-up (You Should Know): display
headsUpShow.description: band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. off: not shown (the mod keeps working).

codebaseMapClaudeMd.title: Codebase Map: CLAUDE.md pointer
codebaseMapClaudeMd.description: auto: keeps a pointer block to docs/blueprints in CLAUDE.md of repos with a blueprint; off: never writes CLAUDE.md and removes the block at the next session start.
